projectDescription: An OpenFGA-to-PostgreSQL authorization compiler that generates specialized SQL functions from .fga schemas to power zero-sync, always-consistent permission checks directly in your database.
keyFeatures: Compiles OpenFGA .fga schemas into optimized PL/pgSQL functions installed directly in PostgreSQL
Zero sync required — permission checks query your existing domain tables via a melange_tuples view
Transaction-aware — permission checks see uncommitted changes within the same transaction
Language-agnostic — generated SQL functions callable from Go, Python, TypeScript, Ruby, or any PostgreSQL client
Single-query permission checks with role hierarchies resolved at compile time
CLI commands: migrate, validate, status, doctor, generate client, generate migration
Optional type-safe Go runtime library (github.com/pthm/melange/melange) with Checker, BulkCheck, ListObjects, ListSubjects APIs
Support for contextual tuples, caching, decision overrides, and cursor-based pagination
Integration with external migration frameworks (golang-migrate, Atlas, Flyway) via generate migration
publicApiSurface: melange migrate — apply schema to PostgreSQL database
melange validate — validate .fga schema syntax
melange status — show current schema migration status
melange doctor — run health checks on authorization infrastructure
melange generate client — generate type-safe client code (Go/TypeScript)
melange generate migration — generate versioned SQL migration files
melange init — initialize a new Melange project interactively
melange config show — display effective configuration
